title: Puthoff's EarthTech papers as a guide

tellings.quote: Pudoff, but I I find his work absolutely fascinating. His entire set of papers on his EarthTech website is every is uh acted as a a mentor-type guide to me.

plain: Dave Rossi, a researcher who says aliens taught him advanced physics, told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that he finds the work of a physicist named Hal Puthoff fascinating. Rossi says the full set of papers on the website of EarthTech, Puthoff's research outfit, has served him as a kind of mentor, guiding his own thinking.
